Title: [VCST-4835] newsArticles — sort publishDate:desc Returns Descending Order
Preconditions: Runner-native. PUBLIC role — newsArticles does not require authentication. Store must have at least 2 published news articles. Sort arg is a plain String (format "field:direction"). Return type is NewsArticleContent (verified via introspection — has id, title, publishDate, content, contentPreview, listTitle, listPreview, tags, isArchived, seoInfo, author).
Assertions:
[ERRORS label=desc_sort] errors[] empty
[COUNT label=desc_sort] data.newsArticles.totalCount >= 2
[DATA label=desc_sort] data.newsArticles.items.0.publishDate is non-null
[DATA label=desc_sort] data.newsArticles.items.1.publishDate is non-null
[EVIDENCE label=desc_sort] items.0.publishDate >= items.1.publishDate — desc sort order — runner-MVP does NOT support cross-path predicates (LHS path vs RHS path); RHS becomes a string literal. Verdict-critical assertion deferred to runner-v2 [MATH] support or sentinel-value rewrite (seed two articles with known dates and assert items.0.publishDate = {{KNOWN_NEWEST}}).
Cross_Layer_Checks: [EVIDENCE] Bug VCST-4835: before fix, sort was ignored. Cross-path comparison documented as EVIDENCE — operator must spot-check the date ordering in evidence JSON until runner-v2 lands.
Failure_Signals: errors[] non-empty; totalCount < 2 (insufficient seeded articles); items.0.publishDate < items.1.publishDate (operator-detectable in evidence — fix regressed); DV-008 on publishDate field
References: VCST-4835; xAPI; Query.newsArticles; runner-feature: cross-path-predicate or [MATH]

Title: Product and category slugs resolve unchanged through the page-first resolver
